detail_json.project_description: CGN Hami Phase I 20MWp Grid-connected PV Power Plant Project (hereafter referred to as ¡°the project¡±) is a newly built photovoltaic power plant located in Hami City, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, P.R.China. The project is to utilize solar energy for electricity generation. The project is constructed and operated by CGN Solar Power Development Co., LTD. The project has a total installed capacity of 20.31MWp, the expected average annual net electricity generation during the whole operation lifetime is 29,846MWh with the plant load factor (PLF) of 16.8%. The electricity generated by the project will be supplied to Northwest China Power Grid (NWCPG). Prior to the implementation of the project, the equivalent electricity supplied by the project was sourced from the NWCPG.
